technology_name: éCoir Bag (Treated Coir Grow Bag) Technology
problem_solved: Plastic grow bags restrict root growth, cause root circling, and create environmental pollution due to non-biodegradability.
description: éCoir BAG is an eco-friendly, breathable grow bag developed jointly by NCRMI and FOMIL as an alternative to plastic grow bags. Made from specially treated coir without using rubber latex, the bags facilitate "air pruning" of roots, prevent root circling, and provide insulation. They measure 27 cm x 27 cm.
applications: • Manufacturing of eco-friendly agricultural grow bags • Production of biodegradable nursery and greenhouse planters • Deployment in urban terrace and indoor gardening • Processing of treated coir fiber into sustainable horticultural products
